title: KiraOrderAiExtractionResponse
description: Standardized response schema for KiraOrder AI Draft Parsing Endpoint (H1/H5 Extraction)

qty.description: Positive integer quantity (1..999999) or null if unevidenced/ambiguous/decimal

uom.description: Unit of measure alias/verbatim (e.g. 'ctn', 'pack', 'kg') or null

fam.description: Product family ID from closed-set catalog or 'UNKNOWN'

pack_size.description: Packaging size specification (e.g. '1kg', '500g', '12 x 1L') or null

conds.description: List of verbatim condition trigger phrases extracted from the span

rows.description: Array of extracted product line items

ignored_spans.description: Array of discarded conversational phrases, chitchat, or non-order spans
